apps.localizedDescription: Mangayomi is a free, open-source app for reading manga and novels and watching anime, available on Android, iOS, macOS, Linux and Windows. It supports extensions for a wide range of sources.
apps.versionDescription:
Mangayomi 0.9.9 | Mangayomi-v0.9.9-ios

## What's Changed
* fix(extension): enable mobile code copy by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1039
* fix(reader): restore double-tap zoom toggle by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1037
* feat(player): add hold-and-slide speed selector by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1038
* fix(http): drop the quotes Linux wraps the saved user agent in by @matsukiender-star in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1036
* fix(security): show what deep links install and keep tokens out of sh… by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1041
* chore: await dropped writes, add guard lints, localize hardcoded strings by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1042
* refactor: move the tracker library cache from Hive to Isar by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1043
* refactor: split large widget files and remove duplicated code by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1044
* Try to fix chapter sorting by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1035
* Add a protected HLS proxy for extension playback by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1040
* Fix reader by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1051
* fix(mobile): improve player controls and error handling by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1047
* fix(restore): improve error handling and reporting during restore ope… by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1052
* fix(reader): pan a zoomed webtoon page without losing double tap by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1054
* ci: run the test suite on pull requests and main by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1056
* Use neutral icons for extension repositories by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1045
* Add western recommendations and trustworthy watch orders by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1050
* Refine portrait player controls by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1058
* fix: recognise "T1" seasons and "Episodio" episodes by @matsukiender-star in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1060
* Hide settings, that the user disabled by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1059
* fix(tv): make Browse overscan safe and focus reachable by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1061
* add useful comments to extension template by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1057


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.8...v0.9.9
